whatIs: UI Colors generates color scales from 50 to 950 from a base color, designed for Tailwind CSS. It lets you create brand, neutral, and status colors (success, info, warning, and error) and preview them on sample cards, sites, dashboards, and charts.
It exports in Tailwind v3 and v4 format, CSS, and SCSS. It's a good fit when you need a custom palette with Tailwind's structure instead of using only its default colors.
uses: Creating a 50–950 scale from your brand color and pasting it into your Tailwind theme.
Building success, warning, and error colors that are consistent with the rest of the interface.
Testing the palette on a sample dashboard before applying it.
caveats: On the free plan you can only create the primary scale: secondary, neutral, and status colors and font selection require Pro.
Export to HSL, OKLCH, and RGB, APCA adjustment, the contrast matrix, and saving palettes with a public link are Pro features.
pricingNote: Free plan with limited features; Pro costs $4.95 per month or $30 per year.
idealFor: Teams using Tailwind that need custom color scales.
